summary: Zambales 2nd District representative with 20 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are paternity and bereavement leave and the national minimum wage, all one labor issue. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
